name: Roasted Vegetable Couscous Tray
ingredients: 1 zucchini, 1 bell pepper and 1 red onion, chunked
1 tsp ras el hanout or cumin and coriander
Juice of 1 lemon, parsley, salt and pepper
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the vegetables, chickpeas and tofu with the oil, spices and salt on a tray.
Place the couscous in a bowl, pour over the hot stock and cover for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Toss the couscous with the roasted mixture, lemon juice and parsley.
note: The chickpeas and tofu bring the protein up so the dish is a full meal on one tray.
